summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to disclose a regulatory notification of major holdings under Irish law. The Capital Group Companies, Inc. reported crossing above 15.00% of total voting rights, increasing from 14.89% to 15.07% as of May 28, 2026. The filing is a routine beneficial ownership update, not a special situation such as an acquisition or tender offer. There is no board recommendation, advisor, price, or transaction mechanics involved. This is purely a disclosure of a passive stake increase by an institutional investor, with no event risk or arbitrage angle.
